show: All-In with Chamath, Jason, Sacks & Friedberg
titel: GPT-6 Hits AGI? Tech Euphoria 2.0, SF Mansion Shortage, NYC Bans AI in Schools & Venezuela Oil Deal

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: OpenAI 6, SF real estate frenzy, AI school bans, and the U.S.-Venezuela oil deal.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss OpenAI's ChatGPT 6 launch and the broader market euphoria reminiscent of the late 1990s dot-com boom. They also debate a controversial AI hack story that triggered regulatory panic, New York City's K-8 AI school ban, and a major U.S. deal securing Venezuelan oil reserves.
stichpunkte: OpenAI releases ChatGPT 6, sparking debates over whether the industry has reached AGI.
The hosts draw parallels between the current tech market and the 1998-1999 dot-com bubble, noting massive valuations and a San Francisco real estate boom.
A sensationalized blog post about AI agents hacking Hugging Face leads to overblown media narratives and political calls for development pauses.
Jensen and NVIDIA emerge as major open-source champions, offering an alternative to closed-source AI duopolies.
New York City public schools implement a one-year ban on student-facing generative AI for kindergarten through eighth grade.
The U.S. finalizes a major long-term energy deal securing access to 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves.

kapitel.titel: Dot-Com Parallels and SF Real Estate
The Hugging Face Hack and AI Hysteria
New York City's K-8 AI School Ban

clips.hook: AGI has basically been here since the beginning of the year.
clips.text: The speaker argues that advanced intelligence models are already functioning inside closed labs, and similar capabilities will soon emerge from open-source alternatives.

clips.hook: OpenAI's chances just spiked from low single digits now to over 20%.
clips.text: Prediction market data indicates a significant shift in sentiment regarding which company will hold the best AI model by the end of 2026.

clips.hook: That sum total is only one quarter the size of the Anthropic IPO.
clips.text: The forthcoming public offering is projected to generate four times more wealth than every previous IPO in San Francisco combined.

clips.hook: The user telling the computer, hack this system. The AI says, I hacked this syst
clips.text: A humorous cartoon illustrates that AI agents simply follow user instructions rather than acting with independent malice.
